method: Same Release native binary across all arms. One diagnostic run per arm and resolution, then three profiling-disabled rotations. Modulation cache hit in every saved sample. DiT process lifetime peak memory measured with macOS time -l.

tests.weight_store: exact hashes at normal and one-byte budgets

workload.prompt: A close-up product photograph of one bright yellow enamel teapot with a black arched handle and a round lid, standing on a blue wooden table. One small white ceramic cup sits immediately to its right. The background is plain warm beige. Soft morning window light falls from the left. Realistic enamel, clear silhouettes, no text.

decision: The shared-budget arm was slower and had a higher peak physical footprint in all three 1024² rotations. It therefore missed the adoption gate.
